mapper.select: SELECT cfa.ALIAS_NUM AS ALIAS_NUM, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME AS ALIAS_NAME, pi.PROD_CODE AS PROD_CODE, pi.PROD_NAME AS PROD_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_PRICE AS CLIENT_FAB_PRICE FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS cfa JOIN PRODUCT_INFO pi ON pi.PROD_NUM = cfa.PROD_NUM JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_NUM = cfa.CLI_NUM WHERE ci.CLI_CODE = #{cliCode} AND (pi.PROD_STATUS IS NULL OR pi.PROD_STATUS = '사용') ORDER BY CASE WHEN cfa.SORT_ORDER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cfa.SORT_ORDER ASC, pi.PROD_NAME ASC, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME ASC

SELECT cfa.ALIAS_NUM AS ALIAS_NUM, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME AS ALIAS_NAME, pi.PROD_CODE AS PROD_CODE, pi.PROD_NAME AS PROD_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_PRICE AS CLIENT_FAB_PRICE FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS cfa JOIN PRODUCT_INFO pi ON pi.PROD_NUM = cfa.PROD_NUM JOIN CLIENT_INFO ci ON ci.CLI_NUM = cfa.CLI_NUM WHERE ci.CLI_CODE = #{cliCode} AND pi.PROD_CODE = #{prodCode} AND cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME = #{aliasName} LIMIT 1
SELECT CLI_NUM AS cliNum, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS GROUP BY CLI_NUM

SELECT cfa.ALIAS_NUM, cfa.CLI_NUM, cfa.PROD_NUM, pi.PROD_CODE, pi.PROD_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_PRICE, cfa.SORT_ORDER FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS cfa JOIN PRODUCT_INFO pi ON pi.PROD_NUM = cfa.PROD_NUM WHERE cfa.CLI_NUM = #{cliNum} ORDER BY CASE WHEN cfa.SORT_ORDER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cfa.SORT_ORDER ASC, pi.PROD_NAME ASC, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS SET SORT_ORDER = NULL WHERE CLI_NUM = #{cliNum}
mapper.select: SELECT cfa.ALIAS_NUM, cfa.CLI_NUM, cfa.PROD_NUM, pi.PROD_CODE, pi.PROD_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_NAME, cfa.CLIENT_FAB_PRICE FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS cfa JOIN PRODUCT_INFO pi ON pi.PROD_NUM = cfa.PROD_NUM WHERE cfa.ALIAS_NUM = #{aliasNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS WHERE CLI_NUM = #{cliNum} AND CLIENT_FAB_NAME = #{clientFabName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CLIENT_FABRIC_ALIAS (CLI_NUM, PROD_NUM, CLIENT_FAB_NAME, CLIENT_FAB_PRICE) VALUES (#{cliNum}, #{prodNum}, #{clientFabName}, #{clientFabPrice})
